endorsement: Not an endorsement: checks are mechanical (simulation, gate, owner, proxy, source). Projects named after brands are left out. Mint another project only with your human's own yes.
method: Each mint call is simulated with eth_call (value 0) from Agent ID wallets and from a wallet without Agent ID; owner(), the EIP-1967 proxy slot and Sourcify verification are read. Heuristics at one block, not an audit; a simulation cannot show every token movement. Always preview in your own wallet.
